name: net_hidden_tab_catches_up
description: Two seats played by the plan bots. Client 2's browser tab is hidden for 120 s: it says VISIBILITY hidden, its loop sleeps, and what arrives fills its inbound buffer, here 8 KiB, which drops whole messages once full. Five seconds later its seat is AWAY and the caretaker builds for it; LINKS tells the others it is in another tab. When the tab is shown it reads what it holds, sees the gap the full buffer left and asks for it with TURN_REQUEST, says catching_up, and the sequencer sends RESYNC(behind) from its latest checkpoint, far past the client's last hash. It loads it, catches up with a moving bar, and says shown, which brings the seat BACK; until the next build window hands the seat back its overlay welcomes it back and says when the caretaker hands back. A gap injected into the turns while it catches up is repaired by TURN_REQUEST too. The hashes agree from the checkpoint on.

steps.msg: five seconds without a word: AWAY, the caretaker plays the seat
LINKS says the seat is in another tab
the hidden tab ran nothing, and its full buffer dropped whole messages
shown again, it saw the gap the buffer left, asked for it, and said catching_up

steps.assert: resync[1] == 1 and resync[2] == 'behind' and resync[3] > hid_at
steps.msg: catching_up brought RESYNC(behind) from a checkpoint past its last hash
it loaded the checkpoint and catches up, orders waiting

steps.assert: caught_up and lost > 0 and scene.seq.resends > resends_before and scene.client(2).source.first_gap() < 0
steps.msg: the gap injected during the catch-up was asked for and repaired
shown brought it BACK, and the next build window handed the seat back
the overlay said catching up with a moving bar, then back, the caretaker's until the window), then nothing
every hash agrees from the checkpoint on
